name: Home Assistant
author: Reto Wietlisbach
description: Home Assistant in the Omarchy bar: live entity states, a curated dashboard you pick yourself, and a searchable browser for every entity.

barWidget.description: Bar pill with a keyboard-friendly panel: pick entities, toggle lights and switches, adjust brightness and climate, run scenes.

schema.label: Transport
schema.description: Auto uses the live WebSocket bridge (python3) and falls back to REST polling if it cannot start.

schema.label: Polling interval (seconds)
schema.description: Only used while polling. WebSocket updates are pushed instantly.
